# ISuperstateArkEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/ISuperstateArkEvents.sol)

**Title:**
ISuperstateArkEvents

Events emitted by Superstate Ark contracts


## Events
### SubscriptionExecuted
Emitted when a subscription (deposit) to Superstate is executed


```solidity
event SubscriptionExecuted(uint256 usdcAmount, address target);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`usdcAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of USDC subscribed|
|`target`|`address`|The address that the subscription was directed to|

### RedemptionExecuted
Emitted when a redemption from Superstate is executed


```solidity
event RedemptionExecuted(uint256 shareAmount, uint256 expectedUsdc);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shareAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of shares redeemed|
|`expectedUsdc`|`uint256`|The expected USDC amount to be received from the redemption|

### SweepSlippageUpdated

```solidity
event SweepSlippageUpdated(Percentage oldSweepSlippage, Percentage newSweepSlippage);
```

### DepositSlippageUpdated

```solidity
event DepositSlippageUpdated(Percentage oldDepositSlippage, Percentage newDepositSlippage);
```
